title: A piece of work spanning more than one session

work_directories.description: Absolute paths this project is worked on in. Many-to-many: a directory may host several projects.

repos.description: Owner/Repo for each work directory that is a git checkout.

issues.description: Links to the GitHub issues this project's status lives in — usually its area epic and current milestone epic. When set, they are the source of truth for progress: check them before trusting current_state.

current_state.description: Where the last session stopped, in a few sentences. Overwritten, never appended — the history is in the notes and in git.

current_state_at.description: When current_state was last written, so a handoff can say how stale it is.

weight.description: How much tracking structure this project carries, lightest first: none, single-doc, phased. 'none' is metadata only.
